newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: NABISCO UNIT TAPS ALASKA NETWORK.
newsitem.headline: NABISCO UNIT TAPS ALASKA NETWORK.

text.p: Alaska Milk Corp has signed an agreement with Nabisco International for the distribution of Nabisco biscuits in the Philippines.

"Alaska's tie-up with Nabisco is only a precursor to the company's efforts to further expand its revenue base and diversify its product portfolio in the medium term," said Alaska in a statement on Tuesday.
Alaska said the pact allows the company to venture into the four billion peso local biscuit market.
Alaska said the agreement takes effect this month. Nabisco International is a unit of Nabisco Holdings Corp.
